target_customer: Large companies in Latin America (banks, insurers, retailers, consumer goods) buying upskilling for teams
problem: Latin American corporate teams lack digital product, growth and data skills; Kurios sold cohort-based online courses taught by professionals from firms such as Google, Amazon and Stripe.
business_model: B2B cohort-based training sold to companies

founders.name: Carlos Lau
prior_employers: Uber Latam (early employee, growth and operations in Peru; launched UberDost)

founders.name: Luis Alonso Ubillas
founders.background_notes: Per YC page he built go-to-market, operations and finance and sold to Walmart, AB InBev, Scotiabank and Yape across eight countries.

investors: Angels incl. John Danner and Austen Allred

competitors.name: Coderhouse
competitors.what: Live cohort-based online courses for LatAm professionals in data, coding, design and marketing
competitors.traction_then: Revenue grew 10x since 2019 to a $12M run-rate

competitors.name: Crehana
competitors.what: On-demand skills development for enterprises in Latin America

competitors.name: Platzi
competitors.what: Pre-recorded online courses for Latin American professionals

technical_complexity.rationale: Delivering live cohort courses is mostly content, instructors and sales, with off-the-shelf video and learning tools.

defensibility.rationale: Enterprise relationships and instructor network helped, but content and cohorts were copyable by Coderhouse, Platzi or Crehana.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors raised capital in 2021 (Platzi $62M Series B in December 2021 per TechCrunch) and none were reported to have copied or bought Kurios.

market_need_then: YC page claims 65 B2B customers and 90% completion; in 2021 LatAm reskilling platforms were raising millions (TechCrunch, August 2021).

branding.domain_note: Uses kurios.la, a Latin America ccTLD, not kurios.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Spanish-language B2B voice about empowering teams for a digital and AI world

branding.community_and_virality: Website lists a podcast, blog, whitepapers and a WhatsApp community.

brand_strength.rationale: Content marketing and client logos show some presence, but the name is confused with Cirque du Soleil's Kurios and other marks, and no brand press was found.

outcome_analysis: Kurios sold cohort-based digital skills training to large Latin American employers, claimed 65 B2B customers on its YC page, and raised a $2.3M seed in June 2022 to enter Mexico. The YC directory marks it inactive while its website and a search snippet suggest it still operates with training and expert coaching, so the cause of any stall is not public and no failure factor is assigned.
notes: Status conflict: YC page fetch says Inactive, a search snippet quoting YC says Active, and kurios.la is live with a 2023 footer. Exit left unknown. Bloomberg Linea named Carlos Lau as CEO but also wrote founder names inconsistently. Investor list: Bloomberg Linea names YC, Rethink Education, Necessary Ventures, Harvard Management, Michigan and Integra; other trackers list Sprint VC, DVC, Xploration Capital, 110X Impact, Gaingels; these are unverified. Total raised estimates range $2.3M to $2.43M. Competitor sources come from search summaries (Coderhouse, Crehana: TechCrunch August 2021, which is a few months after the S21 batch start; Platzi 2019). Brand search returned only unrelated Kurios marks.
